title: The Sentinelese — the last uncontacted tribe on Earth
voiceover: There's an island in the Indian Ocean that no outsider has ever successfully visited. It's called North Sentinel Island. The people who live there — the Sentinelese — have been there for about 60,000 years. They have refused contact with the outside world for all of recorded history. They greet visitors with arrows. In 2018, an American missionary tried to land there to share his religion. He was killed within minutes. His body was never recovered. The Indian government has made it illegal to approach the island. Everyone on Earth knows about them. None of us have ever spoken to them. They've outlasted every empire in human history by saying no. Follow Mindbloom for one fact a day.
